Winter cash assistance
PLAN

550,000 people

Period
Winter 2024-2025; September 2024 plan

UNHCR: Ukraine Winter Response Plan 2024-2025, updated September 2024

Where to find it
PDF p. 1, cash support

UNHCR REPORTED

258,345 people

Period
September 2024-March 2025 summary; April cash narrative specifies October-March

UNHCR: UNHCR Ukraine Winter Response 2024-2025: Post Distribution Monitoring Key Findings (July 2025)

Where to find it
PDF p. 1, Cash Assistance row and footnotes

Assessment
46.97% of original people target

The plan also gives 263,000 households. That is a different unit, not the denominator used here. Figures are UNHCR self-reports and remain subject to verification.

Follow-up
Kharkiv's official reported a resource ceiling and 170 households awaiting bank checks in January 2025. Separately, the Ministry said technical difficulties prevented some 2024 UNHCR payments. These identify specific constraints, but do not apportion the national 291,655-person gap. Household figures cannot replace people, and the later regional payment total does not reconcile the pending cases. A later global report's two cohort figures also need reconciliation with the seasonal total; neither is silently substituted.

Sources: Households in frontline regions to receive additional funds for heating season · Why fewer than half of Kharkiv winter-cash applicants received UAH 21,000 · Kharkiv regional administration update: winter cash delivery paragraph · Cash assistance in 2025: Main outcomes from post distribution monitoring

Calculation
258,345 / 550,000 × 100 = 46.97%; difference: 291,655 people.
